title: 第2785章 场内场外第2784章 重中之重
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
这一炉聚灵丹，对赵宇而言，同样是一场极为严苛的考验。
就算自己神魂远超常人，但能否炼丹制器，仍是另一回事。
所以，这次赵宇的各个动作也变得缓慢起来。他把各环节的把控，变得慎之又慎。
那表情已凝重许多。
这时，丹阁大广场处的人越来越少。因为第一波的，针对四阶丹师至六阶丹师的考核已经开始了。
第一轮的考核也是同样，先是笔试。
第二轮才是炼丹。
四阶至六阶丹师的笔试时间，也是三天。
所以，此时此刻的大广场处，变得清静许多。
赵宇这次的测试，不但对他自己意义重大。对其他丹师也触动甚大，准确一点是。
是一种刺激，一种激励。
三天的考核一结束，许多参加考核的丹师，又立刻拥向大广场，想再次领略一下这位少年“逼王”的风采。
特别是那帮女丹师，连自己的成绩如何，能不能过关都不去关注了。
可惜的是，这位牛气冲天的逼王已经退场了。
于是，这群人再次四处打听结果如何？
最后的结果是，这逼王过关了。
且成了丹阁历史上第一位，仅以百岁之龄，又以四阶虚仙。成就八阶虚仙境丹师，且被丹阁认证的绝代妖孽。
但还有稍许遗憾，因为最后一炉丹药，只有五颗成丹。
这个消息，在丹阁中再次掀起滔天巨浪。
有人赞赏，有人惊叹。

同样有人妒忌，有人愤怒，有人憎恨，且恨之入骨。
这对别人而言，已经算是空前绝后。
可赵宇也把众人的胃口拉高了，似乎这家伙不以全优成绩结束，便是缺憾。
实际上，炼制最后一炉的聚灵丹依然大功告成，成了三颗八星级，五颗七星级。
则是中间被赵宇顺走了三颗。
这三颗，一颗赵宇要给百里长奇。当时百里长奇受伤，至今仍未完全痊愈，特别是神魂处。
而另外两颗，则留下备用。
毕竟一炉五颗成丹，且达到优秀级，已经很罕见了。
至此。
此事已告一段落，虽有少许遗憾，更多的是兴奋。
但是，另有一个更为惊爆的消息，再次在丹阁中炸响。
事情是这样的
待丹阁这次所有考核结束，赵宇还有三场挑战赛要举行。
笫一场是，赵宇要挑一位丹阁的某位长老。这人就是当时一直与赵宇过不去的那人，最后确认这人就是丹阁一位长老。
而且是位八阶虚仙级丹师，一位来自总务堂的长老。
另外两场的挑战，则是别人对赵宇发起挑战。
这三场挑战，都得到双方及丹阁的认可。
content_en:
This furnace of Spirit Gathering Pill is also an extremely harsh test for Zhao Yu.
Even if his soul is far superior to ordinary people, whether he can refine elixirs and make weapons is still another matter.
Therefore, Zhao Yu's movements became slower this time. He controlled every link very carefully.
The expression was much more solemn.
At this time, there were fewer and fewer people in the main square of Dan Pavilion. Because the first wave of assessments for level 4 to level 6 alchemists have already begun.
The first round of assessment is the same, with a written test first.
The second round is alchemy.
The written examination time for fourth-level to sixth-level alchemists is also three days.
Therefore, the main square became much quieter at this moment.
Zhao Yu's test this time is not only of great significance to him. It also greatly touched other alchemists, to be precise.
It is a stimulus and an incentive.
As soon as the three-day assessment was over, many alchemists who participated in the assessment immediately flocked to the main square, wanting to appreciate the elegance of this young "King of Forces" again.
Especially those female alchemists, they don't even care about their own results or whether they can pass the test.
It's a pity that this arrogant and aggressive player has already left the game.
So, this group of people asked around again. What was the result?
The final result was that the king passed the test.
And he became the first person in the history of Dan Pavilion, who was only a hundred years old and a fourth-level virtual immortal. A peerless evildoer who has become an eighth-level Alchemist in the Void Immortal Realm and has been certified by the Alchemy Pavilion.
But there is still a little regret, because the last batch of elixirs only has five completed elixirs.
This news once again caused huge waves in Dan Pavilion.
Some people admire it, some people marvel at it.
Likewise, some people are jealous, some are angry, and some are hateful, and they hate it to the core of their being.
For others, this is unprecedented.
But Zhao Yu also whetted everyone's appetite. It seemed that if this guy didn't finish with straight A's, it would be a shortcoming.
In fact, the last batch of Spirit Gathering Pills was successfully refined, with three eight-star pills and five seven-star pills.
Three of them were taken away by Zhao Yushun.
Of these three, Zhao Yu wants to give Baili Changqi one. Baili Changqi was injured at that time and has not fully recovered yet, especially his soul.
The other two are kept as spares.
After all, it is very rare to get five adult pills in one furnace and reach the excellent level.
So far.
This matter has come to an end. Although I have a little regret, I am more excited.
However, there was another even more shocking news that exploded in the Dan Pavilion again.
The thing is like this
After all the assessments in Dan Pavilion are completed, Zhao Yu still has three challenges to hold.
In the first scene, Zhao Yu wanted to choose an elder from the Dan Pavilion. This person was the person who had been having trouble with Zhao Yu at that time. It was finally confirmed that this person was an elder of Dan Pavilion.
Moreover, he is an eighth-level virtual immortal level alchemist, an elder from the General Affairs Hall.
In the other two challenges, others challenged Zhao Yu.
These three challenges were recognized by both parties and Dan Pavilion.
